post.description: Queues one account-level intent (market orders, deals, power creep management) for the next tick, as if issued by the caller's script. The official client uses it to issue `suicidePowerCreep` (`{id}`) from the power creep panel. The payload is wrapped in a one-element list and sanitized with the engine intent table; unknown names queue nothing but still succeed.

post.summary: Queue a manual object or room intent

The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). `activateSafeMode` is refused while any of the caller's controllers has active safe mode (`safe mode active already`). The payload is sanitized with the engine intent table (only schema fields kept; unknown names store `{}`), merged into the caller's queued manual intents for that target (`$merge`: objects deep-merge, arrays merge index by index), and the room is activated.

post.description: Places a construction site for the caller without needing room visibility. Validation: coordinates 0..49, a `CONSTRUCTION_COST` structure type, name ≤ 50 characters and required for spawns (`invalid params`); The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). The spot must be valid (`invalid location`: not on the room edge, an extractor only on a mineral, not on a same-type structure/site or blocking structure (ramparts excepted), not on a wall (roads excepted), not next to an exit, and beside the edge only next to edge walls (roads/containers excepted)); the controller must not be owned/reserved by someone else (`not a controller owner`); the RCL must allow another structure of the type (`RCL not enough`); the caller must have fewer than 100 sites (`too many`). Mutation: inserts a `constructionSite` with progress 0 and `progressTotal` = construction cost (roads ×5 on swamp, ×150 on wall) and activates the room.

post.description: Creates a flag, or moves the caller's flag with the same name, without needing room visibility. Validation: numeric `x`/`y` within 0..49, string `name` ≤ 60 characters, valid colors (`invalid params`); The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). Mutation: a flag with the same name is first removed from whichever room holds it and saved; then, if the caller already has `FLAGS_LIMIT` (10000) flags, the request fails with `flags limit exceeded` (the old flag stays removed); otherwise the flag is appended to the room's flag list (`name~color~secondaryColor~x~y`, `|`/`~` in names escaped).

post.description:
Starts playing: places the caller's first spawn at `x`,`y` in a free room. Preconditions: coordinates 0..49 and name ≤ 50 characters (`invalid params`), account not blocked (`blocked`), non-zero CPU (`no cpu`), at least 180 s since the last respawn (`too soon after last respawn`), playable room (The target room must exist, be a world room (`W…`/`E…`, otherwise `not supported`), and be inside the borders and open (`out of borders`). / `invalid room`), the caller owns no room objects (`already playing`), the controller exists (`invalid room`) and is unowned, unreserved and not bound to another user (`room busy`), and the tile is a valid construction spot (`invalid location`). Mutation: other players' creeps and construction sites in the room are removed, their structures become ruins (decaying after 100000 ticks), the level-0 controller is claimed at level 1 with 20000 ticks of safe mode, sources reset `invaderHarvested`, the spawn is inserted with 300 energy, the room's `invaderGoal` becomes 1000000, the room is activated, and the user's `active` counter becomes 10000. See `userWorldStatus` for the precondition state.

Placing the initial spawn of an account has been observed to reset the account's CPU allocation to the selected shard; callers must not assume a previously configured allocation (`userCpuShardsSet`, `POST /api/user/cpu-shards`) survives.

200.description: Spawn placed. Logical failures are reported with HTTP 200 and `{error}`: `invalid params`, `blocked`, `no cpu`, `too soon after last respawn`, `invalid room`, `not supported`, `out of borders`, `already playing`, `room busy`, `invalid location`.

GameMapStatsDecoration.description: A decoration activated in the room (screeps.com decoration inventory). `decoration` names its definition in the response's top-level `decorations`; the official world map reads `_id`, `activatedAt`, `decoration` and `active`.

decoration.description: Id of the decoration definition, a key of the response's `decorations`.

active.description: Values of the active decoration; `null` when inactive.

GameMapStatsDecorationDefinition.description: Definition of a decoration referenced by the rooms of a map-stats response. The official world map reads `type`, `graphics`, `tiling`, `foregroundUrl` and `floorForegroundUrl`.

props.description: Configurable properties keyed by name: `type`, `label`, `default`, `readonly` and, for ranges, `min`, `max` and `step`.

rooms.description: Room names. The official world map sends the rooms of the visible sectors.

statName.description: Statistic name suffixed with an interval, matched by `/^(.*?)(\d+)$/`. `owner0` and `claim0` request only ownership data; `<GameRoomStatName><8|180|1440>` (e.g. `energyHarvested8`) additionally requests the ranking of that statistic.

shard.description: Shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations.

stats.description: Stats keyed by room name; requested rooms without a room document are absent.

statsMax.description: Largest ranked value keyed by `statName`; the official world map scales stat circles by it. Absent for `owner0` and `claim0` requests.

decorations.description: Definitions of the decorations the rooms reference, keyed by decoration id (screeps.com).

GameMapStatsRoom.description: Per-room map stats. Room-status fields are copied from the room document; `own`, `sign`, `safeMode` and `minerals0` come from room objects; screeps.com adds `isPowerEnabled` and `decorations`; the requested `statName` key (e.g. `energyHarvested8`) holds the ranking entry for that stat, typed by the community client as a single `{user, value}` object.

isPowerEnabled.description: `true` when the room's controller has power enabled (screeps.com); absent otherwise.

decorations.description: Decorations activated in the room (screeps.com); the official world map draws them.

own.description: Controller owner (`level` = RCL), reserver (`level: 0`), or an invader core with level > 0.

hardSign.description: System sign, typed by the community client only.

safeMode.description: Present when the controller's safe mode ends after the current game time.

name.description: Optional spawn name; the spawn is unnamed when omitted.

shard.description: Shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations.

GamePlaceSpawnResponse.description: Placement acknowledgement. backend-local returns `{ok: 1, newbie: true}`; the official client does not read the body.

GamePublicUser.description: Public projection of a user (`{_id, username, badge}`); fields absent on the user document are omitted.

GamePublicUsers.description: Public users keyed by user id.

shard.description: Shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations.

_id.description: Id of an invader summoned by the caller.

shard.description: Shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations.

GameRoomDecoration.description: Active decoration instance in a room (screeps.com inventory system). The official client reads `user`, `active` and `decoration`; the community client types it as a `DecorationInstance`.

active.description: Values of the active decoration; `null` when inactive.

GameRoomObject.description: Room object document (`rooms.objects`), discriminated by `type`. Each described type has its own schema; required fields are present on every object of that type, other fields depend on how and when the object was created. Dropped resources use `GameRoomObjectResource`; any other `type` (seasonal or mod objects) validates as `GameRoomObjectOther`. Documents may carry further, undocumented legacy fields.

GameRoomObjectCreep.description: A creep. Spawned creeps start with `spawning: true`; NPC creeps (invaders `2`, source keepers `3`, stronghold defenders) are created without `spawning`, `ageTime` or `notifyWhenAttacked`, and `ageTime` is added on the first processed tick.

user.description: Owner user id; `2` is Invader and `3` is Source Keeper.

storeCapacity.description: Total capacity shared by all resources; `null` when only per-resource capacities apply.

spawning.description: `true` while the creep is being spawned.

ageTime.description: Game time at which the creep dies of old age.

ticksToLive.description: Lifetime an NPC invader is created with; the engine derives `ageTime` from the body on the first tick instead.

notifyWhenAttacked.description: Whether the owner is notified when the object is attacked.

interRoom.description: Pending move to another room or shard; `null` once applied.

memory_sourceId.description: Source or mineral a source keeper guards.

userSummoned.description: User who summoned the invader creep.

noCapacityRecalc.description: Store capacity is not recomputed from CARRY parts.

tombstoneDecay.description: Lifetime in ticks of the tombstone the creep leaves.

mission.description: Mission the creep belongs to (creeps created by the game for a mission).

noInterShard.description: The creep cannot travel through inter-shard portals.

userNotActive.description: The owner is inactive; the object does not keep its room processed.

GameRoomObjectPowerCreep.description: A spawned power creep: the account power creep document copied into the room with its position, `hits`, `ageTime` and `actionLog`.

user.description: Owner user id; `2` is Invader and `3` is Source Keeper.

level.description: Controller, power creep, factory or invader core level.

storeCapacity.description: Total capacity shared by all resources; `null` when only per-resource capacities apply.

powers.description: Powers of a power creep keyed by power constant.

ageTime.description: Game time at which the creep dies of old age.

shard.description: Shard the power creep is spawned on.

spawnCooldownTime.description: Real time in Unix milliseconds until which the power creep cannot be spawned.

deleteTime.description: Real time in Unix milliseconds at which the power creep is deleted.

notifyWhenAttacked.description: Whether the owner is notified when the object is attacked.

interRoom.description: Pending move to another room or shard; `null` once applied.

userNotActive.description: The owner is inactive; the object does not keep its room processed.

off.description: Disabled spawn or extension: the room has more of them than its controller level allows.

GameRoomObjectController.description: A room controller. The world generator creates it with `level: 0` only; ownership, progress, timers and safe mode fields are added when it is claimed, reserved or signed, and stay (possibly `null`) afterwards.

progressTotal.description: Progress needed for the next controller level or to finish construction.

downgradeTime.description: Game time at which the controller downgrades.

safeMode.description: Game time at which safe mode ends.

safeModeCooldown.description: Game time until which safe mode cannot be activated.

upgradeBlocked.description: Game time until which the controller cannot be upgraded.

hardSign.description: Sign set by the game, shown instead of `sign`.

bindUser.description: Only this user may claim the controller.

storeCapacity.description: Total capacity shared by all resources; `null` when only per-resource capacities apply.

cooldown.description: Ticks until the structure can act again (links, labs, extractors, factories).

level.description: Controller, power creep, factory or invader core level.

cooldownTime.description: Game time at which the cooldown ends (terminals, nukers, factories, labs, deposits).

userNotActive.description: The owner is inactive; the object does not keep its room processed.

GameRoomObjectInvaderCore.description: An invader core: a stronghold core (level 1 to 5) or a level 0 core that reserves rooms around it.

user.description: Owner user id; `2` is Invader and `3` is Source Keeper.

level.description: Controller, power creep, factory or invader core level.

templateName.description: Stronghold template of an invader core.

depositType.description: Deposit type of the stronghold rewards.

deployTime.description: Game time at which the stronghold deploys.

nextExpandTime.description: Game time of the next expansion of an invader core.

decayTime.description: Game time at which the stronghold collapses.

userNotActive.description: The owner is inactive; the object does not keep its room processed.

nextSpawnTime.description: Game time of the next spawn (keeper lairs).

GameRoomObjectPortal.description: A portal. The official portal generator is not published; fields follow the engine portal processor and live documents.

unstableDate.description: Real time in Unix milliseconds after which the portal starts to decay.

decayTime.description: Game time at which an unstable portal disappears.

disabled.description: The portal is disabled and does not move creeps.

GameRoomObjectRuin.description: A ruin of a destroyed structure.

destroyTime.description: Game time at which the structure was destroyed.

decayTime.description: Game time at which the ruin disappears.

user.description: Owner of the destroyed structure.

userNotActive.description: The owner is inactive; the object does not keep its room processed.

GameRoomObjectTombstone.description: A tombstone of a dead creep (`creep*` fields) or power creep (`powerCreep*` fields).

user.description: Owner user id; `2` is Invader and `3` is Source Keeper.

decayTime.description: Game time at which the tombstone disappears.

creepTicksToLive.description: Remaining lifetime of the creep at death; negative for some creeps without a lifetime.

creepBody.description: Body part types of the dead creep.

creepSaying.description: Public message the creep said when it died.

powerCreepId.description: Id of the dead power creep.

powerCreepName.description: Name of the dead power creep.

powerCreepTicksToLive.description: Remaining lifetime of the power creep at death.

powerCreepClassName.description: Class of the dead power creep.

powerCreepLevel.description: Level of the dead power creep.

powerCreepPowers.description: Powers of the dead power creep keyed by power constant.

powerCreepSaying.description: Public message the power creep said when it died.

userNotActive.description: The owner is inactive; the object does not keep its room processed.

GameRoomObjectNuke.description: A launched nuke on its way to its landing position.

landTime.description: Game time at which the nuke lands.

launchRoomName.description: Room a nuke was launched from.

GameRoomObjectResource.description: A dropped resource. The amount is stored under the resource type key and `resourceType` names that key. The engine writes every dropped resource with `type: "energy"`; `type` is still declared as any resource type. A pile created without `resourceType` holds energy under `energy`.

notifyWhenAttacked.description: Whether the owner is notified when the object is attacked.

additionalProperties.description: Amount, keyed by the resource type.

GameRoomObjectOther.description: A room object of a type this contract does not describe (for example seasonal objects or objects of server mods listed in `serverData.customObjectTypes`). Only the base fields are known.

type.description: Object type, none of the described types.

user.description: Owner user id; `2` is Invader and `3` is Source Keeper.

GameRoomObjectStore.description: Stored resources: amount keyed by resource type. An amount may be `null` after its resource was removed; unowned NPC market terminals can hold negative amounts.

GameRoomObjectStoreCapacityResource.description: Per-resource store capacity keyed by resource type (labs, nukers, power spawns and similar); `null` releases a resource slot (lab minerals).

GameRoomObjectBodyPart.description: One body part of a creep.

hits.description: Hit points of the part (0 to 100).

effect.description: Effect id: a power (`PWR_*`) or natural effect (`EFFECT_*`) constant. Absent on the shield effect of ramparts created by a power.

power.description: Power constant of an effect applied by a power creep.

level.description: Power level the effect was applied with.

endTime.description: Game time at which the effect ends.

GameRoomObjectEffects.description: Active effects. Usually an array, but after a power creep applies a power upstream persists the collection as an object keyed by array index (`{"0": {…}}`); read both forms as a collection.

GameRoomObjectActionLogEntry.description: Details of one action of the last tick: usually the target position.

id.description: Target id, or the power constant of a power creep `power` entry.

isPublic.description: Whether a `say` message is visible to other players.

power.description: Power constant of a power creep `power` entry.

x1.description: x of the first source lab (`runReaction`, `reverseReaction`).

y1.description: y of the first source lab.

x2.description: x of the second source lab.

y2.description: y of the second source lab.

GameRoomObjectActionLog.description: Actions of the last tick keyed by action (`attack`, `attacked`, `attackController`, `build`, `harvest`, `heal`, `healed`, `power`, `produce`, `rangedAttack`, `rangedHeal`, `rangedMassAttack`, `repair`, `reserveController`, `reverseReaction`, `runReaction`, `say`, `spawned`, `transferEnergy`, `upgradeController`, …). An entry is `null` when the action did not happen; `spawned: true` marks a power creep spawned in the last tick.

GameRoomObjectPosition.description: A room position; `shard` is set for positions on another shard. The destination of an inter-shard portal holds only `shard` and `room`.

GameRoomObjectSpawning.description: The creep a spawn is spawning.

name.description: Name of the creep being spawned.

spawnTime.description: Game time at which spawning completes.

directions.description: Directions the new creep may leave the spawn in.

user.description: Reserving user id.

endTime.description: Game time at which the reservation ends.

user.description: Signing user id.

datetime.description: Real time of signing in Unix milliseconds.

GameRoomObjectTerminalSend.description: A pending terminal `send` order, executed by the global market processing.

GameRoomObjectRuinStructure.description: The destroyed structure a ruin remembers.

user.description: Owner user id.

GameRoomObjectMemoryMove.description: Cached movement of a non-player creep (invaders, source keepers).

time.description: Game time the path was found.

lastMove.description: Game time of the last move.

GameRoomObjectPowerInfo.description: One power of a power creep.

cooldownTime.description: Game time at which the power is ready again.

GameRoomObjectWallDecay.description: Real-time removal of a constructed wall.

GameRoomObjectStrongholdPopulationEntry.description: One defender a stronghold core spawns.

GameRoomObjectStrongholdPopulation.description: Defenders of a stronghold core. Written as an array, but upstream usually persists it as an object keyed by array index (`{"0": {…}}`).

GameRoomObjectsResponse.description: Every room object of the room plus the public profiles of referenced users (typed by the community client; the official client reads `objects` and `users`).

owner.description: Controller owner, or `null` when the room has no owned controller.

stats.description: Graph points per room stat, oldest first.

statsMax.description: Largest point per `<stat><interval>` key; the official room overview scales its graphs by it.

totals.description: Window total per room stat (the community client documents zero totals as omitted).

GameRoomStatInterval.description: Statistic interval in minutes. Graphs contain 8 points for 8 and 180 minutes and 7 points for 1440 minutes (the official room overview labels 8, 8 and 7 offsets respectively).

GameRoomStatName.description: Per-room, per-user statistic recorded by the engine (`ROOM_STAT_NAMES`).

GameRoomStatus.description: Upstream `_.pick(room, ['status','novice','respawnArea','openTime'])`. Fields absent on the room document are omitted; an unknown room yields `{}`.

status.description: Room status, e.g. `normal` or `out of borders` (the official world map treats `out of borders` rooms as unavailable); the community client also lists `closed`/`novice`/`respawn`.

novice.description: UNIX time in milliseconds until which the room is a novice area.

respawnArea.description: UNIX time in milliseconds until which the room is a respawn area.

openTime.description: UNIX time in milliseconds at which the room opens.

terrain.description: 2500 digits indexed by `y * 50 + x`; each digit is a bit mask: 0 plain, 1 wall (`TERRAIN_MASK_WALL`), 2 swamp (`TERRAIN_MASK_SWAMP`), 3 wall.

GameRoomTerrainTilesResponse.description: Response when `encoded` is absent or empty: every wall and swamp tile, row by row.

rooms.description: Room names; unknown rooms are skipped.
One encoded terrain document per known requested room; the official client reads `room`.

enabled.description: Coerced with `!!`; omitted means `false`. The official client sends the selected object's current flag value.

shard.description: Shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations.

lastTicks.description: Durations of recent ticks in milliseconds.

shard.description: Shard routing. The official client sends `shard` inside the JSON body for POST operations.

endTime.description: Point end as `ceil(time / interval)` in interval units (not a tick or timestamp).

GameTerrainTile.description: One non-plain tile; plain tiles are omitted.

shards.description: Orders keyed by shard name; intershard orders under `intershard` (community client).

MarketMyOrdersResponse.description: The caller's orders grouped by shard. The official client maps each `shards` entry to one order table.

MarketOrder.description: Market order document. `price` is converted from stored thousandths to credits. The community client types public orders without `_id`/`user`/`active`.

createdTimestamp.description: UNIX time in milliseconds of creation.

user.description: Owner user id (null for NPC orders).

MarketOrderIndexEntry.description: Active-order summary of one resource type.

count.description: Active orders (read by the official client).

buying.description: Active buy orders (read by the official client).

selling.description: Active sell orders (read by the official client).

stdeevPrice.description: Community client typing only (spelling as typed).

MarketStatsEntry.description: Daily price history of one resource (`market.stats`).

PowerCreep.description: Power creep account record (`users.power_creeps`). While spawned, `/list` merges the creep's room object over it (adding `type: powerCreep`, `room`, `x`, `y`, `hits`, `ticksToLive`, `actionLog`, …).

spawnCooldownTime.description: `null` while spawned; otherwise the UNIX time (ms) before which it cannot spawn (0 when never spawned).

deleteTime.description: UNIX time (ms) at which a scheduled deletion completes.

shard.description: Shard the creep is spawned on.

powers.description: Power levels keyed by power id (`PWR_*` constant 1..19).

className.description: Value of `POWER_CLASS`; anything else yields `invalid class`.

name.description: Stored as `String(name).substring(0, 50)`: any JSON value is converted (an omitted name becomes the literal `undefined`).

PowerCreepCreateResponse.description: Creation acknowledgement. The official client does not read the body.

id.description: Power creep id owned by the caller.

cooldownTime.description: Game tick until which the power is on cooldown (set by the engine).

name.description: Stored as `String(name).substring(0, 50)`; any JSON value is converted.

powers.description: Complete requested level per power id (missing powers count as level 0, so omitting a learned power is a downgrade and is refused). Only powers of the creep's class, levels 0..5; the sum is the new creep level (max 25).

object.description: Found room object; the official client reads `room`.

GameFinishRequest.description: The official client sends the current room.

time.description: Game tick of the shared history moment.

GameHistoryShareRequest.description: History moment to share, as sent by the official room history view.

code.description: Share code; the official client shows `screeps.com/s/<code>`.

time.description: Game tick of the shared moment.

GameRoomObjectHardSign.description: Controller sign set by the game, shown instead of the player sign until `endDatetime`.

datetime.description: Real time of signing in Unix milliseconds.

endDatetime.description: Real time in Unix milliseconds until which the sign is shown.
